description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Turn a basket 'living' (daily optimisation inside the theme's members, each change gated by a walk-forward test and written to the basket's public ledger, executed with the user's own funds under their standing authorisation) — or turn it off. Returns the ledger and the morning note. (needs your linked account's key)
name: theme_journey_make_living
title: Theme Journey Make Living
